Ideal: callers that require immediate same-port reuse wait for restart-safe listener completion. Actual: the #62 recovery test waits only for raw JoinHandle completion; Ubuntu close-lag evidence shows the exact loopback LISTEN can persist 15-36 ms beyond that boundary, causing immediate EADDRINUSE.

Current production restart is already stronger than the failing test: RuntimeSupervisor::sync_stop_and_wait calls runtime::port::await_listener_shutdown_blocking(handle, port) before start; runtime::port also has async await_listener_shutdown. The failing recovery_transport test directly stop.send()+handle.await and bypasses this boundary.

Acceptance: preserve the single immediate same-port bind assertion; change only the recovery test shutdown observation to the existing production await_listener_shutdown boundary; exact target must pass repeatedly on Ubuntu and Windows, full suites must pass, no sleeps/rebind retries/SO_REUSEPORT/auth-origin behavior changes.
evidence.reference: Issue #62 acceptance plus architecture design run 35975824092

evidence.summary: Root cause: the regression test equates raw listener-task completion with production restart-safe completion. That equivalence is false on sampled Ubuntu kernels: the loopback LISTEN can remain visible 15-36 ms after handle.await. Production supervisor already waits for port release, so the test bypasses the real lifecycle contract. Ruled out: standard ephemeral allocator collision, another test using the same PID range, ordinary TIME_WAIT, and SO_REUSEADDR as a stable standalone fix.

Minimal repair: in src-tauri/src/tools/任务恢复传输v2.rs replace raw handle.await at both listener shutdown points with runtime::port::await_listener_shutdown(Some(handle), port).await after sending shutdown. Do not edit CRITICAL listener.rs/serve/bind_listener. Re-run GitNexus staged detect, exact same-port target repetitions, occupied-port/idempotency behavior and full Ubuntu/Windows suites.
evidence.reference: architecture design run 35975824092; release-observer primitive run 35980510044 proves the release condition is sufficient

evidence.summary: Correction to the earlier root-cause conclusion: the recovery test bypasses production restart-safe waiting, but that is not sufficient to explain the production defect. Linux find_pid_listening_on_port collapses 'no LISTEN' and 'ownerless LISTEN inode still present in /proc/net/tcp' into Ok(None), and runtime::port wait functions interpret None as free. Therefore the existing production restart-safe boundary can itself return early during the verified 15-36 ms ownerless LISTEN tail. The test-only await_listener_shutdown approach is a false root cause/failed repair.
evidence.reference: ARC-8 assess run 36004726833; port observer impact run 36003461930; source src-tauri/src/platform/linux/net.rs + runtime/port.rs; failed test-lifecycle approach run 36003110886

payload.summary: Linux same-port restart can outlive PID ownership because an ownerless LISTEN socket remains visible briefly after shutdown.
payload.content:
【现象】A completed listener task could still fail an immediate same-port restart on Linux with EADDRINUSE.
【根因】The existing port observer equated find_pid_listening_on_port(None) with a free port, but Linux can retain the exact LISTEN entry for a short ownerless interval after process/socket ownership is no longer resolvable.
【修复】Keep PID ownership semantics unchanged, add an exact Linux LISTEN-presence primitive, and make the existing bounded runtime shutdown wait treat ownerless LISTEN as still busy. Callers that require immediate same-port reuse await the established restart-safe runtime boundary.
【验证】Never-merge run 36098896792: staged GitNexus MEDIUM/non-false-clean; exact regression 20/20 on Windows and 20/20 on Ubuntu; complete desktop Rust suites 2/2 Windows and 6/6 Ubuntu, 404/404 each. Earlier close-lag evidence measured 15-36 ms ownerless LISTEN tails.
【来源参考】platform/linux/net.rs; runtime/port.rs; recovery transport regression.
payload.applicability: Applies when a Linux restart contract requires deterministic same-port reuse after graceful listener shutdown. Do not generalize to foreign-process listeners, Windows semantics, or use this as justification for fixed sleeps, blind rebind retries, or SO_REUSEPORT.
